content: First, summaries are mainly composed of linked entities extracted from the original text. In the example, it can be seen that the summary contains four words that refer to different entities. In fact, all noun phrases in the summary mention at least one linked entity. In our experimental data, we extract linked entities from the original text and compare them to the noun phrases found in the summary. We report that $77.1\%$ and $75.1\%$ of the noun phrases on the Gigaword and CNN datasets, respectively, contain at least one linked entity, which confirms our observation.
